Exit 0 after a line-ending repair - see known_risks. Initially FAILED with trailing whitespace on every line of DECISIONS.md.

known_risks: DISC-002b WAS WITHDRAWN DURING THIS PACKAGE AND bootstrap-plan.ps1 WAS DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED. I had claimed a short current_sha made its staleness check no-op silently. It does not - it prints 'WARN STATUS.md has no concrete current_sha'. I had filtered my own output with a pattern omitting WARN, then reported the absence as a finding; my first reproduction attempt also silently failed on CRLF and appeared to confirm it. There is ONE broken guard, not two. Full retraction in DECISIONS.md.

A self-inflicted gate failure worth recording: Python writes on Windows emitted CRLF into files git had committed as LF, and .gitattributes has no *.md rule, so `git diff --check` flagged trailing whitespace on EVERY line of DECISIONS.md. Repaired by normalizing the five modified files back to LF. Any future scripted edit in this repo must write newline=LF explicitly.

The comma-splitting fix means a path legitimately containing a comma can no longer be passed. No such path exists in this repository and the plan's catalog contains none, but the constraint is now real and undocumented in the script's own help.
